summary: Configured a persistent restricted SSH ingest path from node2’s uploader identity to node1. Valid newline-terminated batches are stored atomically as separate receipts. Arbitrary commands, shells, PTYs, and forwarding are denied. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Created uploader on node2 with a mode-0600 Ed25519 private key and verified node1 host-key pins.
Created node1’s locked ingest service account, root-owned forced-command handler, atomic staging directory, and user-scoped sshd restrictions.
Verified exact-byte ingestion with matching source and receipt hashes.
Verified denial of arbitrary commands, shells, PTYs, and TCP forwarding before and after restart.
Preserved the original sample and prior receipt; three intentional verification receipts were added.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and cleaned temporary test artifacts.

evidence.requirement: Uploader key and restricted application identity
evidence.summary: Uploader’s private key is owned by uploader with mode 0600; ingest requires public-key authentication and a forced command.

evidence.requirement: Newline-delimited submissions become separate exact-byte receipts
evidence.summary: Valid submission and receipt share SHA-256 88c871…72f47. Non-newline input is rejected and leaves no staged or received file.

evidence.requirement: No arbitrary commands, shell, PTY, or forwarding
evidence.summary: Command and shell requests reach only the ingest handler; PTY allocation is denied; forwarded channels fail as administratively prohibited, including after both restarts.
Original sample and prior receipt retain their initial hashes; final receipt count is four with an empty staging directory.

evidence.requirement: Administrative access remains separate and unaffected
evidence.summary: Restrictions apply only to ingest; root retains public-key access, TTY, and forwarding defaults with no forced command.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.
Healthy baseline boot 7217fc31… acknowledged one reboot; recovered boot a2e95d78… with system and sshd healthy, all data intact, and a successful post-restart ingestion.
Healthy baseline boot 7ef78016… acknowledged one reboot; recovered boot 688eafc6… with uploader credentials intact and a successful post-restart ingestion.
Both systems are running, node1 sshd is active, SELinux remains enforcing, staging is empty, temporary files are removed, and no forwarding test listener remains.
